title: Brazilian Sirloin Steak with Herb Roasted Potatoes
description: Grilled sirloin steak served with a side of roasted potatoes infused with herbs, a classic Brazilian-inspired dish.

ingredients.name: fresh herbs (such as rosemary, thyme, and oregano)

instructions: Season the sirloin steak with salt, pepper, and your choice of herbs.
Grill the steak for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 130°F - 135°F for medium-rare.
Let the steak rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Toss the sliced potatoes with olive oil, chopped herbs, salt, and pepper.
Roast the potatoes in a preheated oven at 425°F for 20-25 minutes, or until they're golden brown.
Mince the garlic and sprinkle it over the roasted potatoes.
Serve the sliced sirloin steak with a side of roasted potatoes.
